items.evidence: In order for the PIP to pay out, the EPS goal (see #Performance Goals for Performance Incentive Plan on page #) must be achieved.
Sales Growth Goals—To stress the importance of top-line growth, each officer is measured against Abbott's internal targets
Financial Return Goals—While top-line growth is important, that growth must be profitable in order to drive value for our shareholders.
Strategic Initiative Goals—Strategic initiative goals are primarily related to key planned strategic actions, such as portfolio expansion
Leadership Goals—Leadership goals are primarily related to talent and succession planning initiatives.
Strategic initiative goals (portfolio expansion, key R&D milestones, gross margin expansion, entry into new markets)
Leadership goals are primarily related to talent and succession planning initiatives.
each officer is assessed on relevant return goals, primarily earnings, margin contribution, and cash flow.
Adjusted Diluted EPS is diluted earnings per common share from continuing operations excluding specified items.
Adjusted Net Income is earnings from continuing operations excluding specified items.
The calculations of Adjusted Return on Assets and Adjusted Return on Equity reflect adjusted net earnings from continuing operations.
Adjusted Free Cash Flow is operating cash flow less capital expenditures.
Adjusted Sales exclude the impact of foreign exchange on actual sales relative to the goal target.

The Committee believes adjusted return on equity (ROE) is the appropriate performance measure for vesting
